$schema.description: The address of this JSON schema, for editors; codeint does not read it.

source_sets.description: Globs of repository-relative paths that put files into a Source set, whatever the Source set rules say. When globs of several Source sets match one file, the first of vendored, generated, test, and production wins.

budgets.description: The highest ratio each Metric may reach in each Source set; a Metric over its Budget fails the run with exit code 1. A ratio equal to its Budget passes. Codeint compares the ratio as the report shows it, rounded to 4 decimal places.

regression_limits.description: How much each Metric may get worse from the merge-base to the head side before codeint diff reports a Regression and exits with code 1. A key named after a Metric sets its limit in every Source set; a key named after a Source set sets limits for that Source set only. For each setting, the limit of the Source set wins over the limit of the Metric, and a setting left out keeps the default: a ratio rise of 0.01, and new Findings fail only with a numerator rise, except for Import cycles, where any new Finding fails.

languages.description: Which Language plugin measures which folders. Each entry names a Language plugin, the globs of the folders or files it measures, and the globs it leaves out. Several entries may name one Language plugin; it measures what any of them includes. Without this key, every Language plugin measures the whole repository; with it, a Language plugin measures only what its entries include.

plugins.description: External WebAssembly component Language plugins to load from local paths. Each entry names the plugin, its path relative to the repository root or absolute, and its required SHA-256 hex digest.

title: codeint.json
description: The configuration of codeint, read from codeint.json at the root of the repository.

production.description: Globs of files that belong to the Production Source set.

test.description: Globs of files that belong to the Test Source set.

generated.description: Globs of files that belong to the Generated Source set.

vendored.description: Globs of files that belong to the Vendored Source set.

production.description: The Budgets of the Production Source set.

test.description: The Budgets of the Test Source set.

generated.description: The Budgets of the Generated Source set.

vendored.description: The Budgets of the Vendored Source set.

erosion.description: The highest Erosion ratio, from 0 to 1.

duplication.description: The highest Duplication ratio, from 0 to 1.

verbosity.description: The highest Verbosity ratio, from 0 to 1.

import_cycles.description: The highest Import cycles ratio, from 0 to 1.

erosion.description: The Regression limit of Erosion in every Source set.

duplication.description: The Regression limit of Duplication in every Source set.

verbosity.description: The Regression limit of Verbosity in every Source set.

import_cycles.description: The Regression limit of Import cycles in every Source set.

production.description: The Regression limits of the Production Source set.

test.description: The Regression limits of the Test Source set.

generated.description: The Regression limits of the Generated Source set.

vendored.description: The Regression limits of the Vendored Source set.

ratio_rise.description: The highest rise of the ratio, from 0 to 1, as the report shows it, rounded to 4 decimal places. A rise equal to the limit passes.

new_findings.description: When new Findings fail: any_new_finding fails on any new Finding; numerator_rise_with_new_findings fails only when the numerator rises too, so a Finding that only moves passes; never lets new Findings pass, so that with ratio_rise 1 this Metric never makes a Regression here.

erosion.description: The Regression limit of Erosion in this Source set.

duplication.description: The Regression limit of Duplication in this Source set.

verbosity.description: The Regression limit of Verbosity in this Source set.

import_cycles.description: The Regression limit of Import cycles in this Source set.

plugin.description: The name of the Language plugin, such as typescript-javascript.

include.description: Globs of repository-relative folders or files that the Language plugin measures; a folder covers every file below it.

exclude.description: Globs of repository-relative folders or files inside the included ones that the Language plugin leaves out.

name.description: The name of the external Language plugin.

path.description: Path to the WebAssembly component file, relative to the repository root or absolute.

sha256.description: The required 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the plugin file.
